_about: Song structure verified by eye on per-bar stem levels, drum patterns, spectrograms and the lyric alignment. Sections are bar ranges [bar0, bar1) on the 132 BPM grid (bar b starts at t0 + (b-1)*4*60/132; bar0 = 0 means 'from t = 0'; bar1 = null means 'to the end'). Events use bar/beat positions or measured times. build_song.py turns bars into seconds.

sections.name: intro
sections.description: 0-0.23 s silence (below -60 dBFS), then one bar of soft pad (mix about -30 dB); no drums, no bass. The first sung word 'I' arrives just after the bar-2 downbeat.

sections.name: verse1
sections.description: Lines 0-4 ('I see sparks of AGI...' to '...you're my boss'). Pad + vocal only, no drums; a pulsing bass swells in from bar 7 beat 3 (12.05) and is full from bar 8 (12.96). Intimate, even, mix about -22.5 dB.

sections.name: prechorus1
sections.description: 'ChatGPT, please don't eat me alive' (line 5), landing 'ChatGPT' on the bar-10 downbeat where the four-on-the-floor kick enters (16.60, first drum hit of the song). 'alive' is held into bar 13; bar 13 beats 1-2 have a 16th-note hat roll, beats 3-4 are an a-cappella stop (22.96-23.87) carrying the pickup 'I'm upping my P-'.

sections.name: chorus1
sections.description: First 'I'm upping my P(doom)' chorus (lines 6-11). Each line resolves onto a downbeat: doom@23.87, FOOM@25.69, room@27.51, shrooms@29.33, lies@31.15, eyes@~35.1. Crash + clap on the downbeat 23.87. Kick on every beat, flammed clap on 2 and 4. Bar 21 is vocal-free with a 16th snare fill into verse 2.

sections.name: verse2
sections.description: Lines 12-15 ('We had a stable training run...' to 'I feel my atoms rearranging'). Full drums continue (unlike verse 1), bass lower; steady, driving.

sections.name: prechorus2
sections.description: 'Sydney, please let me free' (line 16), 'Sydney' on the bar-30 downbeat. Bass drops out for the whole pre-chorus; bar 32 doubles the kick to 8ths (build), bar 33 beats 1-2 hat roll, beats 3-4 an a-cappella stop (59.33-60.24) with the pickup 'I'm upping my P-'.

sections.name: chorus2
sections.description: Second 'I'm upping my P(doom)' chorus (lines 17-22): doom@60.24, boom@62.05, moon@63.87, soon@65.69, then 'One E thirty flops a second / That was safe enough, we reckoned'. Crash on 60.24. Snare fill on beats 3-4 of bar 41.

sections.name: verse3
sections.description: Lines 23-26 ('Forward MLP, backward, repeat' to 'Without a single CDR') over the full chorus groove: the densest, most continuous stretch before the breakdown.

sections.name: breakdown_prechorus3
sections.description: The quiet breakdown begins: 'Gato, please don't let me go' (line 27), 'Gato' on the bar-50 downbeat where drums and bass cut out together (89.33). Pad + voice only for three bars; bar 53 brings back 16th hats (94.78) under the pickup 'I'm upping my P-'.

sections.name: chorus3_breakdown
sections.description: Third chorus, sung over the breakdown (lines 28-33, 'as paperclips fill the room' to 'Orthogonality thesis blues'). No bass; a sub boom on the downbeat every two bars (96.60 on 'doom', 100.24, 103.87, 107.51) and a reverbed clap on 2 and 4. Quietest drum section (mix about -23 dB).

sections.name: build
sections.description: One-bar build: full drums return on the downbeat (109.33) with an 8th-note snare roll, still no bass; the voice stutters 'Just, just, just, just' (the lyric 'Just' sung four times, the first on the 4& before the bar at 109.07).

sections.name: bridge
sections.description: Lines 34-39 from 'transformers all the way!' to 'RLHF goes askew'; bass re-enters on the bar-62 downbeat (111.14) under 'trans-'. After 'askew' a wordless melisma (122.73-124.5) leads into the chorus-4 pickup; snare fill on beats 3-4 of bar 69.

sections.name: chorus4
sections.description: Fourth 'I'm upping my P(doom)' chorus (lines 40-44): doom@125.69, Loom@127.51, days@129.33, self-upgrade, 'What did Ilya see?'@~132.96, 'We'll never know'. Full energy. The pickup of line 45 'Was it all for show?' starts in bar 76.

sections.name: was_it_all_for_show
sections.description: Full stop (138.42-140.24): drums, bass and pads cut; only the voice 'all for show?' over near-silence (gaps down to -53 dBFS). 'show' lands on the drop.

sections.name: outro_climax
sections.description: Instrumental climax, the loudest part of the song (mix about -15.5 dB, 140.24-152.96): four-on-the-floor, claps on 2/4, open hats on the off-beats; wordless vocalise only (no lyric lines).

sections.name: outro_tail
sections.description: Drums stop at 152.96; bass and synth pulse on for one bar; at the bar-86 downbeat (154.78) the bass cuts and the synth rings out (-31 to -58 dB over 1.4 s); below -40 dBFS from 155.28; file ends 156.65.
